name: Washington Coast Restoration and Resiliency Initiative

funder.name: Washington State Recreation and Conservation Office (RCO)

summary: Biennial state grants for restoring and protecting land and water habitat along the Washington outer coast, including restoration, planning and acquisition projects. Nonprofits, tribes, districts and corporations can apply.

steps: Contact Coast Salmon Partnership for a PRISM project number

eligibility.rule: Project is in the Coast Salmon Partnership boundary or one of four Coastal Marine Resource Committee boundaries
Native American tribe is federally recognized
Nonprofit has authority to protect or enhance natural resources or related recovery activities
Restoration requests of $350,000 or more have preliminary designs by the final deadline
Project avoids eminent-domain acquisition, pre-start costs, most land leases, mitigation and stand-alone maintenance

documents: Authorization form, unless a tribal sponsor

status.quote: Applications Due- Submit in PRISM December 9, 2025

deadline.quote: Applications Due- Submit in PRISM December 9, 2025

applicant_types.quote: Nonprofit organizations with authority for the protection or enhancement of natural resources or related recovery activities

geography.quote: any watershed between Cape Flattery and Cape Disappointment that drains directly into the Pacific Ocean

access.quote: Start Your Application Learn How to Apply

window.quote: Funding comes from the sale of bonds and is awarded every two years.

co_finance_required.quote: No match is required, though it is encouraged.

eligibility.quote: In the geographic boundary of the Coast Salmon Partnership, which includes any watershed between Cape Flattery and Cape Disappointment that drains directly into the Pacific Ocean OR In the geographic boundary of one of the four Coastal Marine Resource Committees
Native American tribes (must be federally recognized)
Nonprofit organizations with authority for the protection or enhancement of natural resources or related recovery activities
Grant request of $350,000+ requires preliminary designs by final application deadline.

Property acquisition through eminent domain. Property acquired before the project start date of the project agreement without a Waiver of Retroactivity. Restoration activities before the project start date of the grant agreement. Construction material purchased before the project start date. Most land leases. Mitigation projects. Maintenance as stand-alone projects.

documents.quote: Detailed Cost Estimate • Tabs by project type. • Estimate for 2027 start. • Align w/PRISM Costs. • Roll contingency costs into categories NOT line item. • Revised for rounding grant request. 29 Required Attachments - Landowner Acknowledgement

Required Attachments - Authorization Form • Governing board is aware of the project application. • Designates authority to apply for and enter into agreement. • Requires a governing body resolution. • Can list multiple projects. • Not required for tribal sponsors. 31 Required Attachments - Priority Habitat & Species Parcel Report

after_award.quote: The sponsor must enter two progress reports a year for each funded project using the PRISM online progress reporting tool.
